label: One
resolution: In the bounded proposition-2 reading, one predicated of a participant means received unity, Exemplifies x unity; not one means nonidentity with the designated One, x ≠ one. These are different propositions, not P and not-P. This projection does not settle the fuller of-itself/through-participation distinction. Reusing the shared participation interface supplies no identity of the Proclean One with a Platonic Form and imports no Platonic nonidentity axiom. Neither sense asserts an essential-quality inventory; that rejected strengthening is recorded in docs/proclus-unity.md.
